TermTranslation.definition: A test that looks for blood in the stool that cannot be seen with the eyes.
The thin, moist lining of the stomach that makes juices to help with digestion and mucus to protect the stomach.
A test that uses high-frequency sound waves to make pictures of structures and organs inside the body.
A test that uses a hollow tube with a light and camera to look inside the mouth, down the throat and esophagus to the stomach and upper part of the small intestine.
A test that uses x-rays to make a series of pictures of the upper gastrointestinal (GI) tract, including the esophagus, stomach and duodenum.
